Method of Attack: Encrypts files using AES encryption with AES key encrypted by RSA-2048 public key
Terminates security and database related processes to shut down security programs and close files
Creates registry key EnableLinkedConnections to access mapped drives in UAC processes
Restarts LanmanWorkstation service to ensure networking and mapped drives accessibility
Deletes Shadow Volume Copies and Windows backups to prevent file restoration
Copies itself to %UserProfile%\AppData\Roaming\svchostt.exe and creates scheduled task to run every 30 minutes
Creates ransom note files with contact emails in encrypted folders
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with mapped drives and network shares
Systems running security software and database services (processes targeted for termination)
Systems with user profiles and common Windows folders
